cards.f: Standard form: what must be true?
cards.b: A × 10ⁿ with 1 ≤ A < 10 and n an integer.

cards.f: Sign of the power in standard form
cards.b: Large numbers: positive power. Numbers less than 1: negative power.
Multiply the A parts, add the powers, then adjust so 1 ≤ A < 10.
Divide the A parts, subtract the powers.

cards.f: Add or subtract numbers in standard form
cards.b: Convert to the same power of 10 (or to ordinary numbers) first. Do not add the powers.

cards.f: Bounds of a value rounded to a given accuracy
cards.b: Half a unit either side. 7 cm to the nearest cm: 6.5 ≤ l < 7.5.

cards.f: Bounds for a + b and a × b
cards.b: Upper: both upper bounds. Lower: both lower bounds.
Upper = a(max) − b(min). Lower = a(min) − b(max).
Upper = a(max) ÷ b(min). Lower = a(min) ÷ b(max).
